framework.name: Next Generation Science Standards (Illinois Learning Standards for Science) and the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science
framework.note: Science and how-to units cite NGSS performance expectations as adopted in the Illinois Learning Standards for Science; history units cite the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science. The Adult units use the high-school codes as a reference point. Alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification.
